note: The third independent review of 1.24.7 (2026-11-07), by an agent that had not seen AI_SCENE written: 287 pictures right as written and 45 wrong ones, each with the question it was drawn for. On the draft it reviewed, 26 right pictures were changed or questioned and 15 wrong ones were mended into another wrong picture. 'after' is the picture as Lantern now draws it, looked at side by side with the picture as written. The one right picture Lantern still changes is a band written twice in a row: the line written again is left out, and the picture is the same.
